grounding.states: Oakville, Ontario has no open Costco yet
grounding.from: Oakville, Ontario has no open Costco yet.

grounding.states: first Oakville warehouse on Wyecroft Road near Burloak Drive, target opening fall 2027
grounding.from: The first Oakville warehouse is under development. An "Opening Soon" sign has gone up at the Wyecroft Road site near Burloak Drive. Demolition is done and the target opening is fall 2027.

grounding.states: Burlington warehouse at 1225 Brant St, Brant St and Plains Rd E
grounding.from: Burlington: 1225 Brant St, Burlington, ON L7P 1X7, phone (905) 336-6714. The hnhbhealthline.ca listing puts it at Brant St and Plains Rd E.

grounding.states: no driving distances or times available to either warehouse
grounding.from: I found no driving distances or times from any part of Oakville to either warehouse.

value.answer: Oakville doesn't have a Costco open yet. The first one is being built on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, targeting fall 2027. For now the closest open ones are in Burlington at 1225 Brant St (Brant and Plains Rd E) and Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd. I don't have drive times, so I can't tell you which is closer.
